description: The basic Responses probe every product runs on OpenAiResponses.

input.content: Give me the first capital letter of the english alphabet and this letter only

checks.says: exactly one message item in output (function calls aside)
checks.jq: (.output // []) as $o | ([$o[] | select(.type != "function_call")] | length) as $other | (if ($o | length) == 0 or $other == 0 then 1 else ([$o[] | select(.type == null or .type == "message")] | length) end) == 1

checks.says: the assistant's message is exactly A
checks.jq: ([.output[] | select(.type == null or .type == "message")][0]) as $m | $m != null and $m.role == "assistant" and (($m.content[0].text // "") | gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$"; "")) == "A"
